subject: Safelist PO triggering and onboarding forms
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@heliohealth.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@procurepoint.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary safelist for small monthly usage + onboarding docs

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — HelioHealth is excited about Redwood for inference on clinical-notes summarization. Procurement asked me to reach out with two asks so we can get a short pilot started this month:

1) Onboarding forms: I attached our completed vendor intake and a proposed SOW (short pilot scope) for your team to review. Can you confirm the address to send the signed copy?

2) PO policy exception: Our finance team has a strict PO workflow that kicks in for any vendor where monthly spend exceeds $5,000. For the pilot we expect spend to be under that threshold, and fast start is helpful. Is there a temporary safelist / single-invoice onboarding lane you can enable so we can be billed monthly without a PO until we exceed the threshold? If not, please advise what minimal evidence you need to consider an exception.

Attachments: [HelioHealth_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf (PDF), SOW-HelioHealth-2026.docx (DOCX)]

Appreciate any quick guidance so we can finalize legal and finance.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Data Partnerships
HelioHealth
elena.morales@heliohealth.io
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@heliohealth.io>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary safelist for small monthly usage + onboarding docs

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the materials and for the clear ask. Quick notes from procurement/finance side:

- We received the onboarding PDF and the SOW. I uploaded both to our intake queue; I also sent the SOW to legal for a light review.

- Safelist / single-invoice lane: we do have a temporary invoice-only path for low-touch pilots but it requires (a) completed vendor intake, (b) evidence of liability insurance or a waiver, and (c) a point-of-contact in finance for billing.

To evaluate an exception faster, please provide:
  • Proof of insurance (COI) or confirmation you are covered under your parent org.
  • A short list of expected monthly spend for the pilot (ballpark is fine).
  • The name and contact email for your accounts-payable contact.

If the pilot spend stays under $5k/mo and the COI is in place, I can escalate for a temporary safelist that will allow monthly invoicing without a formal PO for up to 90 days. I will need Priya to confirm from the finance side and Marissa will coordinate the SOW/legal redline if needed.

Next steps:
- Elena: send COI and AP contact.
- Priya: if you can confirm internal risk threshold for invoice-only lanes (cc'd).
- Marissa: please flag any legal concerns in the SOW and propose a minimal addendum for pilot terms.

Thanks — I can push this through once we have the COI and AP contact.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@heliohealth.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@procurepoint.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary safelist for small monthly usage + onboarding docs

Kimberly —

Thanks, really helpful. Attached is our COI and the contact at AP (accounts-payable@heliohealth.io / Mary Chen). Our forecast for the pilot is $800–1,600 per month depending on token usage.

Notes: Tom from ProcurePoint (cc) is supporting our vendor setup on the platform side and suggested that a simple safelist rule could be: invoice-only for vendors with expected monthly spend < $5k and invoice aggregation turned on; PO required only when a single invoice exceeds $5k or cumulative 30-day spend exceeds $5k. Would Redwood be comfortable with that trigger logic as a conditional exception?

We are happy to sign a short pilot addendum limited to 90 days. If you need anything else, please let me know — I'll also upload the signed SOW to the Drive link you shared.

[Attachment: HelioHealth_Certificate_of_Insurance.pdf (PDF)]

Best,
Elena
